summary: loanDepot, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $100 million of its Class A common stock through BTIG, LLC as sales agent. The stock trades on NYSE under symbol LDI; last sale price $1.32 per share. The agent will use commercially reasonable efforts on a best-efforts basis, earning up to 2.0% commission. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), not a transformative special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist event is involved. The filing is a standard equity distribution arrangement, not a special situation.
